blogs.title: Beyond Fine-Tuning: How Orthogonal Finetuning is Revolutionizing AI Art
blogs.description: A high-level overview of the 'Orthogonal Finetuning' (OFT) method, explaining the common problem of 'catastrophic forgetting' in diffusion models. This post will introduce how OFT offers a principled way to adapt massive models like Stable Diffusion to new tasks without losing the high-fidelity semantic knowledge they learned during pretraining.

blogs.title: The Geometry of Neurons: Why Preserving Angles is Key to Better AI Images
blogs.description: A deep dive into the intuition behind the paper. This post will simplify the concept of 'hyperspherical energy' and explain the authors' finding that neuron angles (rather than just weight magnitude) hold the key to visual semantics. It will explain why rotating neurons is safer than stretching them.

blogs.title: Faster, Stable, and Precise: How OFT Outperforms LoRA and ControlNet
blogs.description: A practical comparison focusing on performance metrics and training stability. This post will highlight the empirical results showing OFT's superior convergence speed and its ability to generate high-fidelity images without the 'model collapse' issues often seen in popular methods like LoRA or DreamBooth.

blogs.title: From DreamBooth to ControlNet: The Future of Personalized AI Generation
blogs.description: An application-focused piece exploring how OFT improves specific use cases. It will detail how the method enhances 'subject-driven generation' (putting a specific dog in a new context) and 'controllable generation' (using sketches or poses to guide the image), showing its versatility in real-world creative workflows.
